key_idea: Try every first-row size x with second row x or x-1; the flag works iff S is a multiple of the pair sum or leaves remainder x.
sketch: Loop x from 2 to S-1. For (x,x-1): valid when S mod (2x-1) is 0 (even number of rows) or x (odd number of rows). For (x,x): valid when x divides S. Iterating x ascending and emitting x-1 before x gives the required order. O(S). Pitfall: exclude the trivial 1-row and 1-column layouts, which the x range 2..S-1 does automatically.
